text.tspan: La semana: lunes, martes, mie'rcoles, jueves, viernes, sa'bado, domingo.
[Los sa'bado y domingo son] fin de semana = [Sat. & Sun. are]weekends
El lunes/.../domingo = on monday/.../sunday. Los lunes/...=by mondays/..
Estaciones del an'o: el invierno, la primavera, el verano, el oton'o.
Meses del an'o: enero, febrero, marzo, abril, mayo, junio, julio, agosto,
A cua'ntos estamos hoy?/Que' fecha es hoy? = What date is it today?
En que' mes/estacio'n del an'o estamos? = What month/season is it?
El primero(only first day of month)/uno/dos/tres de enero/febrero/...
0 cero | 100 cien | 1000 mil | 1001 mil uno | 1215 mil doscientos quince
1 uno | 11 once | 21 veintiuno | 31 treinta y uno | 200 doscient(o/a)s
2 dos | 12 doce | 22 veintido's | 32 treinta y dos | 300 trescient(o/a)s
9 nueve | 19 diecinueve | 29 veintinueve | 100 ciento | 115 ciento quince
10 diez | 20 veinte | 30 treinta | 101 ciento uno | 132 ciento treinta y dos
2014 dos mil catorse | 3032 tres mil treinta y dos | 1 000 000 un millon
100 000 cien mil | 200 000 dos cientos mil | 2 000 000 dos millones
que hora es?(what time is it?): 1:00 es la una en punto | 2:00(... 11:00)
son las dos (... once) en punto | 12:00 son las doce/es mediodia | 24:00
es medianoche | 9:05 son las nueve y cinco | 8:15 son las ocho y cuarto
8:30 son las 8 y media | 1:40 son las 2 menos veinte | 9:45 son las diez
por la(s) man'ana(s)(madrugada/tarde/noche) = in the morning(s)(~).
2:15 A las dos y cuarto de la madrugada = At two fifteen in the morning
A eso de las 3 = around 3 | dentro de 10 minutos = in 10 minutes.
[bindings, pointers, prescriptors] | hay → to have + object(presence)
hay + un/una(single only rule) + noun | hay + nouns/no hay + noun(s)
a → pointer to moving direction or action target (a + el = al)
[ir] + a → pointer to planned action | en → pointer to location
de → pointer to origin/owner/discussed/material (de + el = del)
[gustar] = like | [gustar] inf. = [.] like/love to (v) | much(o/a)s = many
[poder] = [.] can | [poder] que ... = [.] have to ... | hay que ... = need to ...
[proponer] inf. = [.] propose/offer to do (v) | demasiado = too much
[querer] = want | [gustar] inf. = [.] want to do (v) | ma's = more/further
[saber] = [.] know | [saber] inf. = [.] know how to (v) | much(o/a) = much
[ser] → to have + props(adj) | [tener] que tener = [.] have to have
[piensar] en = think about | [tratar] de inf. = try/attempt to (v)
a la (izquierda/derecha) de = to the (left/right) of | [a] menos =[too] less
arriba = above | abajo = below | debajo de = under | muy = very | o = or
alrededor de = around | fuera de = outside of | dentro de = inside of
ante (el/la) ... = in front of ... | detra's de = behind | lejos de = far from
delante de = in front of | enfrente de ... = opposite/infront of ...
opuest(o/a) = opposite | contra = against | contrari(o/a) = contrary
cerca de = nearly | cercan(o/a) = nearby | mas cercan(o/a) = closest
al lado de = beside/near | junto a = next to | encima de = over
desde ... hasta .../(time/languages case) de/del ... a/al ... = from ... to ...
antes de = before | durante = during | mie'ntras = while | rato = a while
en medio de = in the middle of | entre = between | casi = almost/nearly
despue's de = after | luego = then | ma's tarde = later | caso = attention
en profundo ... = deep in ... | al fondo del = at the end of | caso = case
es que ... = the thing is ... | en vez de = instead of | a veces = sometimes
es decir = in other words | esto significa = this means | cada = each
estacio'n de ... = ... station | sin = without | sino = but | ni = neither/nor
en promedio = on average |generalmente = generally|common = comu'n
tal = such | tan = so | tanto = so much | tant(o/a)s = so many| solo = only
negarse a = refuse to | informar de = inform about
[verbs] non absolute rules. [./v] - conjugated pronoun(i/.../we) or verb.
[PARTICIPIO] P | inf. end → P end: -ar → -ad(o/a)(s) | -er/-ir → id(o/a)(s).
imponer → impuesto (imposed/condition forced to be followed) |

( inf.-se: target reverse pointer. Case: irse(leave). Ex.: nos [vamos] )
( inf.-se: [inf.] + target reverse pointer Ex.: [quieremos] irnos)
(before verb: conjugated tense. Ex.: le digo = i tell him)
([inf.] inf. Ex.: *les* [puedo] decir / [puedo] decir*les* = i can tell them)

al inf. = when verb. Ex.: al subir/bajar = when go up/go down.
X years ago | long time ago | recently | early | [before] yesterday |
hace X an'os | hace mucho | hace poco | temprano | [ante]ayer |
last night | today | now | soon | [after] tomorrow | that day
anoche | hoy | ahora | pronto | [pasado] man'ana | aquel di'a
Ex: El habla raro y claramente. El habla raramente. Ella habla raramente.
dejar de inf. = stop verb.(-ing/activity) | dejar inf. = allow to |
dejar caer = drop | dejar en paz = leave alone | quedar = meet |
quedar(se) = leave somewhere(stay somewhere) | quedar en = stay in |
quedar (noun) = stay (in condition) | quedar(se) con = stay with |
cua'l(es) ... ? = which one(many) ... ? | cua'ntos ... ? = how many ... ?
cua'ndo ... ? = when ... ? | desde cua'ndo ... ? = since when ... ?
do'nde ? = where ? | ado'nde ? = where to ? de do'nde ? = where from ?
[shortcuts]. Replace nouns with pronouns, when context announced:
= /i'm to you *her(the truth)* telling/. Rule:replacer-pronoun(*la*) is last
= /i have to tell *you* *her(the truth)*/. Rule: +tela(solid after verb)
el nin'o *le* trae *(las) flores* *a la nin'a*
= /*to her* *them(the flowers)* brings/. Rule: le/les → se.
[*] bien → mejor = [*] good → better | [*] mal → peor = [*] bad → worse
mucho → ma's = a lot → more | [*] poco → menos = [*] bit/little → less
Ex: slow → very slow → extreamly slow → slowly → extreamly slowly
N(noun). Before N rule: (el/la/l(o/a)s) mism(o/a) N = same N
After N/proN rule: N mism(o/a) = N (one/it)self

end | yo | tu' | ud.(es) | nosotras | (gerundio*) | gerundio |

pedir | pedi' | pediste| pidio'/pidieron | pedimos | *asked for

[VOZ PASIVA] noun. se [inf.[el(los)/ella(s)]] → noun. is/are in verb.
[[ ]] = what+when conjugated . [[ser]] P → was/were/will be verb.
[[ser]] P por pronoun → was/were/will be verb. by someone/something.

Ex: no habi'a hecho antes de irme → i had not done before leave.

hacer | [no hagas]/haz | [no] haga(n) | [no] hagamos | *[do not] do

Ex(ustedes): sentarse → [no] se sienten | trae'rselo → [no] se lo traigan.
[ir] a inf. = going to v | [empezar] a inf.= begin(scheduled) to v
[ponerse] a inf. = start(spontaneously) to v | [echarse] a inf.(emotions)
[echar] a inf. = start(suddenly) to v(actions) | ↑(start feel any emotions)
[terminar] de inf. = end(scheduled) to v | [dejar] de inf. = end to v
[acabar] de inf. = just v(made activity right now/just a moment ago)
[soler] inf. = usually v | [volver] a inf. = (back to v)again do/have v
[necesitar] inf. = need to v | [tener] que inf. / [deber] inf. = must to v
hay que inf. = need(abstract/with no executor) to make/do something
[dejar] inf. = allow/let to v | [hacer] inf. = force [pronoun] to v
